identitySignals: Agenda item is an 'Independent Auditor's Report on Compliance' by EideBailly for fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, matching Eide Bailly LLP, a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest (audit) services (eidebailly.com About Us)
OUSD's own legislative record (File 25-1091) shows Eide Bailly presenting the District's Fiscal Systems Audit to the Board of Education, with an eidebailly.com contact address
Eide Bailly's education industry page says it serves 500+ school districts and educational institutions, matching OUSD's governance/audit contract
research.notes: Address and phone are for the Fargo, ND office, which Eide Bailly's headquarters is generally listed at (search results); the cited Fargo page does not itself say 'headquarters'. No Oakland office exists. No general email, EIN, CA entity number or UEI verified.

profile.summary: Eide Bailly LLP is a certified public accounting (CPA) and advisory firm. It provides tax, accounting, audit, technology consulting and mergers-and-acquisitions advisory services to businesses, governments and schools. It has more than 50 offices in the United States and India.

review.notes: Eide Bailly LLP is a licensed CPA firm offering attest services, and OUSD's Legistar record (File 25-1091) shows Eide Bailly presenting audit work to the Board, so the organization matches the independent auditor's compliance report. The cited Fargo page does not call that office the headquarters (it lists it as one office), so headquarters is unsupported; the other fields match the cited pages.
